color.note: Dark is the primary theme: footage reads best on a dark workspace. Light carries the same roles. Overlays on the video canvas and clip fills are identical in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Application background behind floating panels and the timeline. Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Workspace backdrop around the video canvas. Text on it: text-primary.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Inspector panels, transport bar, track headers. Default ground for text-primary, text-secondary, text-muted, text-link.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, tooltips. Same text rules as bg-panel.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, selects, segmented controls and secondary buttons. Pair with border-control.

tokens.name: bg-field-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for fields and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-field-selected
tokens.usage: Selected segment inside a segmented control. Pair with an inset border-strong ring.

tokens.name: bg-timeline
tokens.usage: Timeline surface behind tracks, clips and the ruler.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Translucent hover wash for ghost buttons and rail items. Never a text ground by itself.

tokens.name: bg-scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between panel sections and track rows. Not for control boundaries.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of inputs, selects, segmented controls and slider tracks. 3:1 on bg-panel in both themes.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and selected boundary for controls.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text, values and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Row labels such as Weight and Align, inactive segment text, secondary icons on bg-panel and bg-field.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Units, captions under fields, placeholder, ruler labels on bg-panel, bg-field and bg-timeline.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast; pair with opacity-disabled semantics and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, danger-fill and collab fills.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links and active tool icons on bg-panel, bg-raised and bg-field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, slider fill, the Export action. Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent. Darker in both themes so white text stays at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tool and toggled icon button wash. Pair with a 1px selection ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px, offset by 2px of the surface colour). 3:1 on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selection outline of a clip or a canvas object on UI surfaces.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line and head on bg-timeline. 3:1 against it.

tokens.name: canvas-selection
tokens.usage: Selection outline on the video canvas. Same in both themes because it sits over footage.

tokens.name: canvas-handle
tokens.usage: Fill of resize and rotate handles on the video canvas.

tokens.name: canvas-handle-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline that keeps canvas handles visible on bright footage.

tokens.name: caption-bg
tokens.usage: Plate behind burned-in subtitles. 72% black keeps caption-text above 4.5:1 over any frame.

tokens.name: caption-text
tokens.usage: Burned-in subtitle text on caption-bg.

tokens.name: collab-1
tokens.usage: Collaborator colour 1 (violet) for cursor labels and avatar rings. Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: collab-2
tokens.usage: Collaborator colour 2 (magenta). Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: collab-3
tokens.usage: Collaborator colour 3 (teal). Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: collab-4
tokens.usage: Collaborator colour 4 (burnt orange). Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: clip-shape
tokens.usage: Fill of shape and sticker clips. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-text
tokens.usage: Fill of text clips. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-caption
tokens.usage: Fill of subtitle clips. Label in text-on-accent.

tokens.name: clip-video
tokens.usage: Fill of video clips; thumbnails sit inside. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-audio
tokens.usage: Fill of audio clips; waveform drawn in on-clip. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: on-clip
tokens.usage: Label, icon and waveform ink on clip-shape, clip-text, clip-video and clip-audio.

tokens.name: clip-edge-shape
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of a shape clip. 3:1 on bg-timeline.

tokens.name: clip-edge-text
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of a text clip. 3:1 on bg-timeline.

tokens.name: clip-edge-caption
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of a subtitle clip. 3:1 on bg-timeline.

tokens.name: clip-edge-video
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of a video clip. 3:1 on bg-timeline.

tokens.name: clip-edge-audio
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of an audio clip. 3:1 on bg-timeline.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons beside a check icon and a word. Teal, not green, so it parts from danger for colour-blind users.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons beside a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons beside an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons beside an info icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (Delete clip). Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: danger-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for danger-fill.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Launch screen and empty project headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog titles and section headings in docs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text, input values, menu items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in menus and dialogs, selected segment text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row labels in the inspector: Weight, Align, Case, Color.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under fields (Size, Spacing, Height) and helper text.

styles.name: clip-name
styles.usage: Clip and track names on the timeline.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Current time and duration. Tabular figures, set in bundle.css.

styles.name: ruler
styles.usage: Ruler tick labels only. Each label repeats the timecode, so no information lives at this size alone.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to badge, clip handle inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap inside segmented controls, between stacked icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its caption, between toolbar buttons, clip padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Field inner padding, gap between rows inside a panel section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel section padding, default button padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Inspector panel horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and the canvas; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Dialog and empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large layout gaps.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page-level gutters in the web app and docs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tooltips, tiny badges, trim handles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Clips on the timeline, color swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, selects, segmented controls and their segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inspector panels, popovers, menus, transport bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the video canvas frame, app icon corners at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Cursor labels, avatars, zoom slider, pill buttons.

shadow.note: Dark shadows are heavier and carry a 1px light edge, because black shadows vanish on a near-black workspace.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small lift: segmented selected item, slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating inspector panel over bg-canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the export sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px surface gap plus 2px ring. Apply on :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: shadow-clip-selected
tokens.usage: Selected clip outline, drawn outside the clip edge.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact button, icon button in dense rows.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, field, select, icon button.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary transport actions and touch layouts.

tokens.name: size-hit-min
tokens.usage: Smallest allowed pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8). Small glyphs inside it, never below.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the left tool rail.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Width of the inspector panel.

tokens.name: size-track-row
tokens.usage: Height of one timeline track row and its header.

tokens.name: size-track-header
tokens.usage: Width of the track header column.

tokens.name: size-ruler
tokens.usage: Height of the timeline ruler.

tokens.name: size-clip
tokens.usage: Height of a clip inside a 40px track row.

tokens.name: size-playhead-head
tokens.usage: Width of the playhead head.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size. 16px in clips, 24px in the tool rail.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and locked track clips.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Clip being dragged, waveform ink on audio clips.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim strength where an opacity is needed.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: Video canvas and its selection overlays.

tokens.name: z-timeline
tokens.usage: Tracks and clips.

tokens.name: z-playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line above clips.

tokens.name: z-panel
tokens.usage: Floating inspector panel.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the live-region announcements.
